author: Jinxkitzune
quote: I’ve been playing GTA for years and I’ve waited 13 years for GTA six only for it to be a disappointment. The story is absolutely horrible. I feel like I have no freedom whatsoever to do what I want I can’t rob stores kill random npc and earn a fancy penthouse or own multiple variety of cars. The fact that a NPC can have a panic attack and restrict me from stealing their car is stupid. The fact that I can’t kill any npc  I want in their invincible is really dumb. The world map is incredibly tiny compared to GTA five.  Most of the missions are incredibly boring and there’s no true reward.  There’s no fun way to evade  the police anymore because apparently until I change my outfit in car, I can’t go back to that area. The fact that the only way to play this game is to play pacifist and do some type of  family **** is really weird and the fact that I’m restricted to only two characters is really unfair. There should be more involved when it comes to missions There’s no true risk just Rob a few stores shoot car tires and not kill any  npcs this is honestly a joke and I’m very happy. I managed to get my money back. I’m going back to GTA five rockstar should be ashamed of themselves.
